# netbox_virtual_machine_type (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/virtualization/#virtual-machines):

> A virtual machine type represents a technology or template by which a virtual machine is instantiated. For example, you might create a virtual machine type named "t3.medium" or "n2-standard-4" to model a particular cloud instance size.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_virtual_machine_type" "t3_medium" {
  name        = "t3.medium"
  description = "AWS t3.medium instance type"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
